newsitem.title: INDIA: More India units allowed to sell gold to exporters.
newsitem.headline: More India units allowed to sell gold to exporters.

text.p: India's Commerce Ministry, unveiling a new five-year trade policy, said on Monday that it has decided to increase the number of agencies permitted to sell gold for the promotion of exports of gold jewellery.

The ministry said in a statement that only four agencies, the Minerals and Metals Trading Corp, the State Trading Corp, the State Bank of India, the Handicrafts and Handlooms Export Corp, were currently permitted to sell gold to jewellery exporters.

"Further, export-oriented units/export processing zones units in the gem and jewellery sector will be permitted to sell 10 percent of their output in the domestic tariff area on payment of duty," the statement said.
